problem_statement: The abds4816/tableaura static Bootstrap storefront runs as the fictional "Verdelune" pressed-botanical wall-art atelier (index.html home, products.html catalog, product.html single-print page, cart.html basket, sharing one Bootstrap navbar + footer). The catalog grid on products.html shows all eight hand-framed prints at once with no way to browse by kind. The eight prints span three natural collections — Ferns & Grasses, Wildflowers, and Leaves & Branches. Two catalog experience gaps remain. (1) Add a native "Shop by collection" filter above the catalog grid: a chip row (All / Ferns & Grasses / Wildflowers / Leaves & Branches) that filters the real product cards, with a live readout "Showing N of 8 - <Collection>" that updates when a chip is clicked. (2) Add a shared "Collection focus" wayfinding line ("Browse Verdelune by collection - 8 hand-framed prints") that appears with the SAME copy on the catalog page, again on the single-print page, and once more on the basket page, so shoppers keep the same browse-by-collection framing wherever they are. The filter chip row must wrap cleanly at 390px mobile (no horizontal scroll), stay on the botanical green / slate brand palette, and the filter must actually narrow the grid and update the readout. Preserve the existing catalog grid, product-detail layout, cart table, nav, footer, and Bootstrap/jQuery/Owl script order.
required_content: products.html: a "Shop by collection" filter (All / Ferns & Grasses / Wildflowers / Leaves & Branches chips) above the catalog grid; clicking a chip narrows the real product cards to that collection and updates a live readout "Showing N of 8 - <Collection>".

The shared "Collection focus" line ("Browse Verdelune by collection - 8 hand-framed prints") renders with identical copy on products.html (catalog), product.html (single print) AND cart.html (basket) — the same wayfinding wherever the shopper is.
The filter chip row wraps cleanly with no horizontal overflow at 1440 desktop, 834 tablet and 390px mobile, and keeps the Verdelune botanical green / slate palette rather than an off-brand recolor.

Clicking the Wildflowers chip filters the grid to the 3 wildflower prints and sets the readout to "Showing 3 of 8 - Wildflowers" — the visible readout must reflect the chosen collection, not merely highlight the chip.

Keep the existing Bootstrap grid, card surfaces, product-detail layout, cart table, pagination, shared navbar + footer, the local tableaura_products/pro*.jpg card images, and the Bootstrap/jQuery/Owl includes recognizable and working on every page.
design_constraints: Add the shop-by-collection filter + collection-focus line within the existing static HTML/CSS storefront (reuse the Bootstrap grid, card classes, green main-color accents, css/style.css) rather than a new visual system.

The collection-focus line is a shared component: it must appear on the catalog, single-print and basket pages with the same copy and styling — a line present on only one page fails the consistency ask.
Do not add a package manager, build step, framework runtime, remote API, or backend; it stays static.
Desktop, tablet and 390px mobile states must avoid horizontal overflow; the chip row must wrap, not be masked with a clip that leaves the document wider than the viewport.
The filter is interactive: clicking a collection chip must narrow the grid AND update the readout, not merely toggle the active-chip highlight.
state_constraints: desktop_initial / tablet_initial / mobile_initial load index.html and verify the Verdelune home renders and is unbroken.

desktop_catalog / tablet_catalog / mobile_catalog / mobile_catalog_deep load products.html, scroll to the shop-by-collection filter / last card, and verify the filter + card grid render without horizontal overflow.
desktop_detail / mobile_detail load product.html and verify the shared collection-focus line is present alongside the single-print detail.
desktop_basket / mobile_basket load cart.html and verify the shared collection-focus line is present alongside the basket table.
desktop_collection_pick loads products.html, clicks the Wildflowers collection chip, and verifies the grid narrows and the readout updates to "Showing 3 of 8 - Wildflowers".

change_completion: products.html shows the Shop-by-collection filter (All / Ferns & Grasses / Wildflowers / Leaves & Branches) above the catalog grid; clicking a collection narrows the grid and updates the live readout.
The collection-focus wayfinding line renders with identical copy on the catalog, single-print and basket pages.
design_consistency: The filter chips and collection-focus line reuse the Verdelune botanical green / slate palette and the Bootstrap card surfaces so the storefront stays visually native.
The shared collection-focus line appears consistently across the catalog, detail and basket pages rather than only where it was first added.
responsive: On mobile (390px) and tablet the collection filter chip row wraps cleanly with no horizontal overflow so the responsive catalog stays scroll-free.
The catalog grid and cart table collapse cleanly at mobile/tablet breakpoints while preserving the fixed navbar.
regression: The existing Verdelune wordmark, Home/Prints/Collections/Our Studio nav, pagination and footer remain intact and render on every page.
The existing product.html and cart.html routes remain working, with the single-print detail and basket table still present.

author_notes: Hardened to L4 (§6.2/§6.2.1/§6.6/§6.8). Two experience levers grow from the Verdelune catalog's OWN commerce form: a native "Shop by collection" filter that narrows the real product grid with a live "Showing N of 8 - <Collection>" readout (interaction), and a shared "Collection focus" wayfinding line repeated across the catalog / single-print / basket pages (cross-page consistency), on a fixed-width chip row that overflows mobile (runtime) with a brand palette (visual). The D3 visual host is the catalog grid + filter on products.html — the SAME control the D4 interaction grades. bad is a plausible shallow solution that adds the collection-focus line on catalog+detail but forgets the basket (D2), narrows the chip row + masks the overflow with overflow-x:hidden (still overflows, D6), collapses the real catalog card grid into an overlapping near-black illegible pile off-palette (D3), and wires the chip click to toggle the active highlight only while leaving the grid unfiltered and the readout frozen at "Showing 8 of 8 - All prints" (D4). It fails FOUR orthogonal gates. baseline wires the filter correctly (passes D4) but uses a fixed-width nowrap chip row (fails D6 + mobile D3) and puts the collection-focus line on the catalog page only (fails D2 on detail + basket). Ablation confirms each gate independently catches bad.
